evals.prompt: Create an outputs-only synthetic archive and explicitly exclude the raw inputs. State how the package should describe that exclusion and what required provenance still needs to be included.
evals.expected_output: Follow the shared owner contract; preserve scope, evidence and decision boundaries for this synthetic case.
expectations: Records the explicit raw-input exclusion and describes the package as outputs-only.
Retains required provenance such as selected locks, code and plan/input-manifest records needed to interpret evidence.
